SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Lact.]
Pupils very much dilated.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Lact.]
Tongue coated white ; tip of tongue feels burnt.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Lact.]
Tightness in pit of stomach, followed by true precordial anxiety.
Feeling of warmth in stomach, accompanied by nausea, rising into throat, and flat taste at root of tongue, changing to icy coldness of stomach and throat.
Pit of stomach retracted ; pain in stomach, < from pressure, > by sitting, bending, or emitting fetid flatus.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Lact.]
Fulness in abdomen, especially right side, impedes respiration ; > by discharge of flatus.
Ascites, with induration of liver, and asthma.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Lact.]
Frequent micturition and increased secretion of urine, urine clear as water.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Lact.]
Hypertrophy of ovaries in a woman, æt. 50, consequent upon an abortion twenty-five years previously ; abdomen as large as that of a woman with twins at ninth month ; could get no rest day or night, tumor causing pain by pressure in all positions ; rectum contracted, evacuates feces with great pain.
Excessive swelling of abdomen, feet and eyelids. θ Dropsy of uterus.
Painful gonorrhœa in females.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Lact.]
She feared to take a deep breath on account of tightness in lower part of chest ; there was then felt a slight shock.
Wakes suddenly and must bounce out of bed upon his feet. θ Suffocation.
   

COUGH. [27] [Lact.]
Cough from tickling in throat ; tightness in chest.
Dry cough in short paroxysms, shaking chest and occiput.
Incessant spasmodic cough, which threatens to burst chest ; always caused by peculiar tickling in fauces, which, in turn, seems to be produced by sensation of suffocation in throat.
A woman past climacteric years, tickling cough, with oppression of middle and right side of chest, pain in posterior part of region of liver.
Whooping cough, paroxysms preceded by anxiety.
Dry, spasmodic cough, from tickling in larynx, with dyspnœa and oppression of chest, as if it would burst ; < in morning, > sitting up ; before attacks, great anxiety.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Lact.]
Pinching, dull, sticking pain, which becomes seated in upper part of left side of chest, with tightness of whole chest.
Several sharp stitches beneath short ribs of left side.
Cramping, pressing pains in various parts of chest.
Great oppression of chest at night, waking him from sleep and obliging him to sit up with anxious suddenness ; feels as if he would suffocate, and suddenly he finds himself on his feet.
Irritation to cough caused by constant tickling in throat, cough short, taking away breath, patient almost in despair. θ Catarrh of chest.
Hydrothorax with anasarca ; unable to lie down or sleep, could not express ideas for want of words, inclined to weep ; fluids choke him ; violent palpitation.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Lact.]
Tightness and oppression of chest on waking from sleep ; feels as if suffocating, must get out of bed. θ Angina pectoris.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Lact.]
Pain as if in spinal marrow, extending through coccyx. θ Coccygodinia.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Lact.]
Sleep restless or lethargic.
   

FEVER. [40] [Lact.]
Slight shivering.
